description: Associates a specified resource with a resource share.

ResourceShareArn.description: Specifies the [Amazon Resource Name (ARN)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-arns-and-namespaces.html) of the resource share.

ResourceArn.description: Specifies the [Amazon Resource Name (ARN)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-arns-and-namespaces.html) of the resource to associate with the resource share.

AssociationType.description: The type of entity included in this association.

Status.description: The current status of the association.

CreationTime.description: The date and time when the association was created.

LastUpdatedTime.description: The date and time when the association was last updated.

External.description: Indicates whether the principal belongs to the same organization in AWS Organizations as the AWS account that owns the resource share.
